settings.title: AI assistant
settings.intro: An AI sales agent for your WhatsApp. It answers new enquiries in seconds, asks what they need, shares your packages and prices, follows up when a customer goes quiet, and hands the chat to your team when a person is needed. It also scores every lead and flags fake ones.
settings.problem: Check the values: the follow-up hours are 0 to 23 and the daily limit 1 to 200.

model.title: AI model
model.description: Set by the platform. The first model answers; the next ones take over when it is busy.
model.offTitle: The AI is not set up on this server yet
model.offDescription: Ask the platform to set AI_API_KEY (and AI_BASE_URL and AI_CHAT_MODELS for the chosen provider). Until then nothing here runs. You can still add what the AI should know.

behaviour.title: How the AI works
behaviour.description: The AI only writes inside WhatsApp's 24-hour window, never to someone who asked to stop, and keeps quiet in a chat a person on your team is answering.
behaviour.autopilotHint: On: the AI replies in every chat, unless a chat is turned off. Off: it replies only in chats you turn on.
behaviour.scoringHint: After each customer message the AI gives the lead its chance to book, why, the next step, and whether it looks fake.
behaviour.name: The AI's name
behaviour.instructionsPlaceholder: Always ask for the travel dates and the number of people. Mention our free airport pickup. Never promise a discount.
behaviour.instructionsHint: How it should speak and what to ask or never say. Prices go in What the AI knows, below.
behaviour.followUpHoursHint: One nudge when a customer goes quiet this long, while the 24-hour window is open. 0 for never.
behaviour.maxReplies: Most AI messages in a chat per day
behaviour.maxRepliesHint: A safety limit, so a chat can't run away.

test.title: Try it
test.description: Ask what a customer might, and see what the AI would answer from what it knows. Nothing is sent.
test.question: A customer's question
test.placeholder: Kerala ka 5 din ka package kitne ka hai?
test.handoff: It would hand the chat to your team: {reason}

knowledge.title: What the AI knows
knowledge.description: Your packages, prices, inclusions, dates and policies. The AI quotes only from these, and hands the chat over when something isn't here.
knowledge.upload: Upload a PDF or text file
knowledge.uploaded: Uploaded. The AI is reading it.
knowledge.fileType: Choose a PDF or a .txt file.
knowledge.empty: Nothing yet. Add your packages and prices so the AI can answer about them.
knowledge.alsoKnown: Your trips' details and your quote packages are known too, without adding them here.
knowledge.removeDescription: The AI won't know it any more.
knowledge.dialogDescription: Write it as you would tell a new salesperson: the package, what's included, the price and its basis.
knowledge.bodyPlaceholder: Kerala 5N/6D: Munnar 2N, Thekkady 1N, Alleppey houseboat 1N, Kovalam 1N. ₹18,500 per person on twin sharing, hotels, breakfast, cab and sightseeing included. Flights extra.

chat.title: AI assistant
chat.info: The AI answers this customer by itself inside WhatsApp's 24-hour window, from what your agency taught it, and hands the chat to you when a person is needed.
chat.notConfigured: The AI is not set up on this server yet.
chat.answering: The AI is answering this chat.
chat.notAnswering: The AI isn't answering this chat.
chat.handedOff: The AI handed this chat to your team.

insight.title: AI insight
insight.info: The AI's view of this lead from its chat: how likely it books in the next two weeks, why, and what to do next. A guess to help you choose who to call first, never a decision.
insight.none: No insight yet: it comes after the customer's next message.
insight.fakeHint: Spam, a test or a wrong number, by the AI's reading.

suggest.label: Suggest a reply with AI
suggest.nothing: The AI had nothing to suggest.
